Cross-tabulate the concept columns of every OMOP table

Source: R/omop-cross-tabs.R
omop_cross_tabulation.Rd

Runs omop_table_cross_tabulation() over every OMOP table in the public schema and stacks the results, giving one table that describes how every concept column in the extract has been populated. This is the input the extract summary report is built from.

Usage

omop_cross_tabulation(db)

Arguments

db

A DBI::DBIConnection object with an OMOP-ES extract registered, as by duckdb_register_omop_es_output().

Value

A lazy tbl with the columns described in omop_table_cross_tabulation().

Details

visit_occurrence_ext_fce is excluded, because its concept tables are already joined on.

The result is a lazy tbl: it is a UNION ALL of one query per table, and is potentially expensive, so collect it once and reuse it rather than recomputing it per section of a report.

See also

omop_es_extract_summary_report(), which renders this.

Other concept cross-tabulation: omop_concept_column_summaries(), omop_concept_summary(), omop_concept_summary_all(), omop_table_cross_tabulation()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
db <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
duckdb_register_omop_es_output(db, extract_path, omop_es_path)
cross_tabulations <- dplyr::collect(omop_cross_tabulation(db))
} # }
